title: Quality Lens: one finding without an opaque score
audience: Developers and reviewers who need quality findings to stay inspectable and actionable.
promise: Turn a Quality Runner finding into a human-owned inspection, disposition, and rerun path.
story: A report contains one named finding with a source location.
Quality Lens preserves the finding identity and exposes that the report is stale.
A human records an explicit disposition rather than letting a score decide.
The disposition is reconciled into a rerun model for the same finding.
verified_locally: W1 normalization accepts the declared Quality Runner report schema.
The stale target state remains visible.
A human disposition is preserved across rerun reconciliation.
The current clean dev checkout passes the repository test, lint, and package checks.
The 1600×900 PNG preview is visually reviewed and legible at the target crop.
open_gates: Directly exercise the VS Code Problems-panel and disposition flow.
Verify a hosted no-auth case page.
Record external GitHub, portfolio, and Handshake readbacks.
claim_boundary: This packet proves the current clean dev checkout's W1 headless pilot, evidence contract, and local binary preview; it does not prove direct IDE acceptance, hosting, or publication.
